title: a one-shot Parquet read that aborts at interpreter exit

findings.claim: a one-shot process that reads a Parquet table with pyarrow's threaded reader can abort at exit (status 134) after the read succeeded: the box rehearsal's terminology check fails in CI, and `trialbox doctor` (run by deploy/check_host.sh as a one-shot container judged by its exit status) can show a false FAIL on a real box after every line said PASS
findings.severity_basis: a person misled (a false FAIL of the doctor or the host check that a rerun clears); the box can be installed
findings.fix: use_threads=False on every pq.read_table in libs/, services/ and tools/; guarded by tests/unit/test_parquet_single_thread_guard_h52.py; the rehearsal command looped in tests/unit/test_parquet_read_exit_abort_h52.py
findings.from: CI runs 44440588251, 44454437549, 44478886311; reproduced 40/600 under load, 0/600 with the fix
